title: Pentagon orders security reviews at 30 unnamed universities
adds: On August 17, 2026 the Department of War said it had ordered 30 unnamed universities to audit their foreign research ties and report by August 31, with future federal research funding at stake. No wrongdoing, funding cutoff or penalty has been shown.
